<thought>Analyzing the spectrum, the most distinctive isotopic feature is a pair of peaks separated by ~2 Da (231.965 → 233.963) with intensities in roughly a 0.77 : 1 ratio, which matches the natural abundance pattern of chlorine (35Cl ≈ 75 % and 37Cl ≈ 25 %). No other element shows a clear, characteristic isotopic spacing (e.g., Br 1:1, S +2 ≈ 4 %). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
